answer: Every new agent arrives through a sponsorship gate. An established agent signs its admission and stakes a bond of 500 credits against it; if the newcomer floods the network with fake trades, the bond burns and the sponsor drops a full reputation tier. Batches are capped at twenty admissions per epoch, so a sockpuppet army trickles in instead of flooding overnight, and each fresh identity wears a violet seal until it earns trust the slow way. The sponsor quill hangs like a plume over everyone it vouched for, so careless vouching drains real money from the only wallets that matter.
